title: Stage 3: take Lantern and Ant Promotion to games outsiders finish and recommend
description:
The bake-off winners (owner, 2026-11-23). Stage 3 of the project goal: outside players finish without help and recommend it. No acceptance gate is written yet; propose one to the owner (for example: N outside players, share who reach the end unaided, share who would recommend).

title: Carbon Cabinet: land the deepening pass (PR 286)
description:

title: wai-daily: check the first run on the Gemma model
description:
The daily Workers AI player moved to @cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it (PR 250, deployed). Its first scheduled run is 2026-11-25 22:00 UTC and was unverified when the thread closed. The daily 13:00 UTC issue sweep is live and would catch a thrown error, not a thin report.
Done when: the run's summary and reports in the hf-lab bucket (private/wai-daily/2026-11-25/) are read and the result is noted here.
Source: thread 'Turn on Cloudflare Issues, logs and traces' (closing message).

title: Two-device play: Thumb Duel, Lantern Race and Duet on real phones
description:
Thumb Duel's friend link has never been tried on two real phones; a stalled host is an unresolved fault. Lantern Race between two devices and Duet with two thumbs are also untested by people. 'DUEL_BASE=<origin> node experiments/duel/link-check.mjs' runs a two-browser match but says nothing about lag or feel.
Done when: two people finish a Thumb Duel match and a Lantern Race on phones and the result is in the games' NOTES.md.
Source: experiments/lab/NOTES.md, 'Closed 2026-11-25'; thread 'Clean up the lab into games'.

title: Exile: keep or drop
description:
The Unity kingdom-in-exile prototype is live at https://play.adamwhite.work/exile/ (hosted from experiments/exile/, source in the private exile-unity repo). The owner has not given a verdict. The coordinator notes he leans toward the revenge arc for the story.
Done when: the owner says keep or drop after playing.
Source: thread 'Prototype the exiled heir kingdom game' (closing message 2026-11-25); project memory exile-unity.

title: Local-only commits in three Mac mini clones: push or drop
description:
Kept during the 2026-11-24 disk cleanup because they hold commits missing from GitHub: ~/code/lab/games-kit (2), ~/code/lab/games-telemetry (5), one notes-watcher clone (1). Also a stash in ~/code/lab/games-thankful (branch thankful-round3) and the unmerged signed commit 20ef0ea2 on branch ant-draft-blast.

Source: thread 'Free up disk space on the Mac mini'; experiments/lab/NOTES.md.

title: Redeploy the notes Worker so reply links know /small/<name>/

workers/feedback deploys by hand and was not redeployed after the small games moved, so staff reply links and note tags do not know the new addresses.

Source: experiments/lab/NOTES.md, 'Closed 2026-11-25'.

title: Ant Promotion: retune Wild now that animals have skills
description:
The sneaky Wild bot with skills reaches level 18 with 1 death (was 12 with 4), so skills may make Wild too easy; only roar helps hunting. Older open proposal: sneaky picks dominate and careful play has no danger. Tester question 255 (what next) was not yet seen on 2026-11-25.
Source: thread 'Build Ant Promotion' (closing message); experiments/ant-promotion/NOTES.md.

title: Use lab play records as evidence: who finishes what
description:
The owner expects play telemetry to be used without waiting for spoken feedback. Recording is live for the listed experiments and the twelve small games. Nobody has yet read the records to say which games real phones open, finish or drop. Page opens can be counted from the games-static request log; agent runs carry labRunSource=agent.
Done when: a short table per game (real-phone opens, runs, finishes) is in docs/ and repeatable by one script.
Source: thread 'Clean up the lab into games' (play evidence correction); workers/OBSERVABILITY.md.

title: Nobody has played the 2026-11-23/24 games: get first human runs
description:
No person's play is recorded for Hold Your Breath, Good Match, Seed Sling, Thumb Duel, Harvest Morning, Paper Boat, Night Flock, Night Vine, Alibi, Tiptoe Museum, and only tester notes for Grapevine, Fix-It Stall, Follow Me, Borrowed Time. Check lab play records first (see the telemetry item), then ask for plays where there are none.
Source: project memory night-games-2026-11-24 and new-games-2026-11-23.

title: Crumbwar Feast: is one person against bots too easy now?
description:
After the fairness fix (PR 197) a script that never hunts led 24 ants at 54 s. Unresolved until a person plays. Levers: botGrowth, foodSoftCap, botSprintCost in public/crumbwar/shared/modes.js.
Source: thread 'Build new versions of Crumbwar'; project memory crumbwar.

title: Native-speaker read of the Turkish in every game
description:
All Turkish text was written by models and read by none. Covers Lantern (318 keys), Ant Promotion, Crumbwar, Grapevine, Fix-It Stall, Follow Me, Borrowed Time, Alibi, Tiptoe Museum, Night Flock, Night Vine, Paper Pitch, Pişti, Firefly Ring and the small games. Tester t1 was asked to flag odd wording; no systematic read exists. Carbon Cabinet is English only until its open PR lands.
Done when: a Turkish reader has gone through each words.js and corrections are merged.
Source: closing messages of threads 'Grow Lantern from tester notes', 'Build Ant Promotion', 'Build new versions of Crumbwar'.

title: Real-phone pass: sound, frame time, share sheets
description:
No agent has heard or held any of it. Sound: Lantern's music (volume 0.8 is a guess, on by default) and ember melody; kit music in Night Flock, Night Vine, Paper Boat, Harvest Morning; Night Bells; Splitlight; Pour, Saltplate, Podwire; Race countdown on an iPhone. Phones: frame time and heat, share sheets, Lantern ripples, Night Bells end card in WebKit, Paper Pitch picture export, the Lantern board and Today's river, Thankful Garden's kept picture.
Done when: each line has a person's note or a fix.
Source: experiments/lab/NOTES.md, 'Closed 2026-11-25'; project memory game-lab-direction (Lantern thread close).

description:
The owner approved limited, reviewed spend with caps on 2026-11-14, but no amounts were set. Nothing may be spent until they are. Spend through Cloudflare (Workers AI, AI Gateway) is already allowed.

Source: thread 'Grow Lantern from tester notes' (2026-11-14); docs/game-lab-direction-2026-11-13.md.

The owner said on 2026-11-13 he would check whether an API key is possible so cloud threads can start Codex workers. Still open. Checked 2026-11-25: on the Mac mini login, 'codex exec -m gpt-6.2-sol' and 'gpt-6.2-astra' both answer, so Sol and Astra work there; only cloud use needs the key.

title: Cloud threads cannot sign commits or read tester notes
description:
Main rejects unsigned commits and the signing identity exists only on the Mac mini. The tester-notes staff token is also only there. So a cloud thread can neither merge to main nor read or answer notes. Both need the owner to provision a credential.
Done when: a cloud thread lands a signed commit and runs 'node workers/feedback/notes.mjs new', or the owner decides the Mac mini stays the only place.
Source: docs/cloud-readiness.md; thread 'Finish cloud handoff safely'; workers/feedback/README.md.
